blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Sen. JV Ejercito urged the Department of Health (DOH) to step up its campaigns on mental health and HIV infections, particularly with the rising cases of suicide and the high incidence of HIV cases among young Filipinos. Speaking at a recent Senate budget hearing, Ejercito emphasized the urgent need to address these interconnected youth crises. “With regard to mental health, we have repeatedly raised the alarm over an increasing number of suicide and mental health cases among Filipino youth, particularly students. We need sufficient funding not only for treatment but also for early detection, counseling, and prevention,” Ejercito stressed. […]...
